changes: Improved the conversation page: the title, date, people, and actions stay at the top while you switch between Summary and Transcript, and you can star a conversation from its page

Clicking the microphone in the top bar now opens a menu to choose Off, Always On or Only Meetings instead of switching modes on each click; the icon stays a microphone in every mode, and waiting for a call has its own ring-shaped dot so green always means recording
A conversation recorded by both your Mac and your Omi device now shows as one row with a badge for each device, and its page lists every recording so you can open or separate one

Made navigation, closing, deleting and copying work the same way across the app: Back returns to where you came from, Esc steps back one layer, every delete can be undone or asks first, and copy actions confirm
